What racecheck, initcheck and synccheck detect and report. The manual is 13.4 while the pinned tool is 2025.1.0.0: pin only paragraphs whose behavior the 2025.1 release notes support, as for the memcheck paragraphs. Anchor ids are unverified proposals.
